## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Financials and Industrials showing clear strength while large-cap Tech presents mixed 1W/1M signals, supporting a neutral, range-bound market.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare pressured: JNJ (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -14.12% | 1M: -14.85%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -10.11%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.26% | 1M: -10.70%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND. Watch INTC for divergence (price up vs negative news); watch IBM (1W: -9.37% | 1M: +12.04%) CORRECTION as trend-exhaustion risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed / rotational: AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND and QCOM (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +16.02%) ABOVE TREND show strength while MSFT (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -8.91%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND show stress; Tech breadth: Technology: 13/24 positive (internal rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND and broad sector gains point to continued cyclical support; Financials breadth: Financials: 15/20 positive (Sector Strength).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Soft / defensive underperformance: JNJ (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND and PFE (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND with UNH (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +3.60%) CORRECTION showing mixed internals; Healthcare breadth: Healthcare: 5/17 positive (Sector Weakness).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Industrials exposure given ABOVE TREND leadership (JPM, CAT, COF) and moderate breadth; reduce exposure to weak Energy names (XOM, CVX) and severely lagging Tech single names (ACN, ADBE). Style: mixed / no clear leadership, remain selective and monitor megacap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND — AI capex follow-through; INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND — momentum but news divergence; JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — operational AI catalyst. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND — commodity weakness; ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND — weak outlook; ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND — continued selling.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (Financials: 15/20 positive) and Industrials (Industrials: 12/15 positive) on cyclical strength. BEARISH: Energy (Energy: 1/10 positive) and Healthcare (Healthcare: 5/17 positive) on weak internals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +2.84% | 1M: -4.39%) RECOVERY for confirmation above recent weekly highs to complete a durable bounce; JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly strength would extend sector leadership; ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND — further downside below recent support would signal deeper trend break.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+60): 1 Top AI stock narrative; NVDA (1W: +2.84% | 1M: -4.39%) RECOVERY — sentiment generally confirming price bounce but 1M still negative. AMZN (+60): AWS Graviton5 news; AMZN (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -5.76%) RECOVERY — news aligns with product catalyst but 1M drag remains. VST (+60): Preferred power provider headline; VST (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-50): analyst valuation warning; INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND — clear divergence (price up vs negative commentary). ACN (-50): weak outlook flagged; ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by sharp price decline. CEG (-45): valuation skepticism on nuclear growth; CEG (1W: +11.09% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND — divergence between bullish operational headlines and some valuation-focused skepticism.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major megacap divergence (multiple large caps with 1W up vs 1M down) and headline-driven sentiment mismatches (e.g., INTC up despite negative analyst note) — watch for trend confirmation or break.
